description: This file contains validation rules and utility functions for form validation in the OrangeHRM system, including date, time, number, file, and string validations, as well as external dependencies for date parsing and internationalization.

classes.name: File
classes.description: Type definition for file objects used in validation functions, including name, type, size, and base64 data.

methods.name: required
methods.description: Validates that a value is present; supports string, number, array, and object types.

methods.name: shouldNotExceedCharLength
methods.description: Returns a validator that checks if a string does not exceed a specified character length.

methods.name: validDateFormat
methods.description: Validates if a date string matches a specified format.

methods.name: shouldBeCurrentOrPreviousDate
methods.description: Checks if a date is today or a previous date.

methods.name: validTimeFormat
methods.description: Validates if a time string matches HH:mm format.

methods.name: max
methods.description: Checks if a numeric value is less than a maximum.

methods.name: digitsOnly
methods.description: Validates that a string contains only digits.

methods.name: numericOnly
methods.description: Validates that a string contains only numeric characters.

methods.name: digitsOnlyWithDecimalPoint
methods.description: Validates that a string is a number with optional decimal point.

methods.name: digitsOnlyWithDecimalPointAndMinusSign
methods.description: Validates that a string is a number with optional decimal point and minus sign.

methods.name: beforeDate
methods.description: Checks if one date is before another.

methods.name: afterDate
methods.description: Checks if one date is after another.

methods.name: sameDate
methods.description: Checks if two dates are the same.

methods.name: endDateShouldBeAfterStartDate
methods.description: Validates that an end date is after a start date.

methods.name: beforeTime
methods.description: Checks if one time is before another.

methods.name: afterTime
methods.description: Checks if one time is after another.

methods.name: sameTime
methods.description: Checks if two times are the same.

methods.name: endTimeShouldBeAfterStartTime
methods.description: Validates that an end time is after a start time.

methods.name: maxFileSize
methods.description: Validates that a file size does not exceed a maximum.

methods.name: validFileTypes
methods.description: Validates that a file type is within allowed types.

methods.name: validEmailFormat
methods.description: Validates email address format.

methods.name: validPhoneNumberFormat
methods.description: Validates phone number format.

methods.name: startDateShouldBeBeforeEndDate
methods.description: Validates that a start date is before an end date.

methods.name: maxCurrency
methods.description: Checks if a currency value is below a maximum.

methods.name: startTimeShouldBeBeforeEndTime
methods.description: Validates that a start time is before an end time.

methods.name: shouldNotLessThanCharLength
methods.description: Checks if a string has at least a certain number of characters.

methods.name: maxValueShouldBeGreaterThanMinValue
methods.description: Checks if a value is greater than a minimum value.

methods.name: minValueShouldBeLowerThanMaxValue
methods.description: Checks if a value is less than a maximum value.

methods.name: numberShouldBeBetweenMinAndMaxValue
methods.description: Validates that a number is within a specified range.

methods.name: validHexFormat
methods.description: Validates hex color string format.

methods.name: imageShouldHaveDimensions
methods.description: Validates image dimensions against aspect ratio with tolerance.

methods.name: greaterThanOrEqual
methods.description: Checks if a value is greater than or equal to a minimum.

methods.name: lessThanOrEqual
methods.description: Checks if a value is less than or equal to a maximum.

methods.name: validLangString
methods.description: Validates language string formatting with braces.

methods.name: validSelection
methods.description: Validates selection input (not a string).

methods.name: validHostnameFormat
methods.description: Validates hostname or IP address format.

methods.name: validPortRange
methods.description: Validates port number within range and length.

methods.name: validVideoURL
methods.description: Validates YouTube video URL format.

methods.name: digitsOnlyWithTwoDecimalPoints
methods.description: Validates number with up to two decimal points.
